_comment: RULE 11: the single source of truth. No literal number, path, port, timeout, limit or label may appear anywhere else. core/src/constants.ts types it; server, sim and ui import it through core. Instrument command facts (headers, ranges, option lists) live in core/src/registry/, next to the code that interprets them, because they come from the programming guide rather than from us.

app.name: MHO Studio
app.tagline: Remote bench for RIGOL MHO900 and Teledyne LeCroy X-Stream scopes

server._comment_no_viewer: no_viewer_stop_s: after the last window closes (and no reload brings one back), disconnect the scope and the board and stop the server; a running sweep or capture is waited for. job_stop_wait_ms: how long quitting waits for a stopped job to put the settings back.

update._comment: The in-app updater (server/update.ts): compares the installed commit (build.json, written by the installers) with a branch of this GitHub repo, downloads that exact commit and runs the platform's installer on it. MHO_STUDIO_UPDATE_API / _RAW / _CODELOAD replace the hosts in tests.

usb._comment: USB-TMC over the rear USB Device port (server/usbtmc.ts). request_bytes is how much of a reply is asked for per REQUEST_DEV_DEP_MSG_IN; replies longer than that come in several.

lecroy._comment: Teledyne LeCroy X-Stream oscilloscopes (WaveRunner / WavePro / WaveMaster / SDA / DDA / LabMaster, running Windows), controlled over VICP: the instrument's GPIB-style messages in 8-byte-header frames on TCP port 1861 (core/src/scpi/vicp.ts, server/vicp.ts). Commands are LeCroy's legacy remote-control set plus VBS automation (core/src/registry/lecroy.ts).

sim._comment: The simulated LeCroy stands in for an unknown 40 GS/s X-Stream model. Every number here is the simulator's own choice, not a datasheet value of any real model.

wire._comment: How waveform bytes are laid out. WORD byte order is detected from the data and then locked (core/src/wave/decode.ts); prefer_word_format reads 12-bit data as 16-bit words so no resolution is lost.

siglent._comment: Teledyne T3DSO1000 / Siglent SDS1000X-E oscilloscopes (the T3DSO1204 is Siglent-made: USB vendor 0xF4EC, firmware 8.3.6.x): Siglent's SCPI on raw TCP port 5025 or USB-TMC. Measured on a T3DSO1204 (fw 8.3.6.1.37R8) on 2026-10-14: header off by CHDR OFF, numbers without units, 14 horizontal divisions, 25 codes per vertical division, waveform data ending in two newlines, screenshots as a raw 800x480 RGB565 BMP, no compound queries.

sim._comment: The simulated T3DSO1204: 4 channels, 1 GSa/s and 14 Mpts per channel pair with one channel of the pair on, 500 MSa/s and 7 Mpts with both. The bench follows the other simulators.

burst._comment: Edge capture: one trigger, one long record, every edge measured (server/burst.ts, core/src/dsp/edges.ts).

board._comment: The STM32H743 board (CORE V1.3) as a Bode generator: its Si5351 on I2C2, set over the board's command link on USART1 (CH340). server/board.ts; packets in core/src/board/protocol.ts. Board Test GUI must not have the port open at the same time.

dac._comment: DAC1 sine (DacSine): both channels, PC4 through OPAMP1 (buffered — use this one) and PA5 direct; both on header P1. Table length and timer rate are chosen together, so the reply carries the frequency produced.

sim._comment: The simulated board: its DAC sine when one is playing, else its lowest CLK output that is on, replaces GEN OUT 1 on the simulated bench, so it feeds CH1 and, through the filter, CH2.
The simulated bench behind 'Simulated MHO984'. Everything it does is listed in sim/README.md; nothing in the app treats it differently from a real scope.
